AgentIdString
Agent Id.
AggregateId
A unique identifier that links multiple alerts.
AssociatedFile
The file associated with the triggering indicator.
CommandLine
The command line used to create this process.
CompositeId
A global unique identifier that identifies a unique alert.
Use this field in the Alerts API, accessed using /alerts/, to perform operations on the detection.
Example value: xxxxxxxx:ind:529fb8e5xxxxxxxx5d577e3f:41104
Hostname
Host name.
customerIDString
Customer ID (cid).
DataDomains
The type of activity associated with an alert.
Identity: user and account activity
Web: HTTP, SSL, TLS, and other web activity
Network: Firewall, NetFlow, DNS, and other network activity
Email: email activity
Endpoint: process and file activity
Cloud: cloud workload and services activity
IoT: internet of things activity
Description
A description of what an adversary was trying to do in the environment and guidance on how to begin an
investigation. Note: While these descriptions are robust and drive a helpful console experience, we encourage you
to not use this field to drive workflows, as values are updated and added regularly
Name
Detection name.
HostGroups
Contains the comma separated list of Host Group IDs.
Tactic
The name of the tactic associated with the behavior.
Tags
Contains comma separated list of FalconGroupingTags and SensorGroupingTags.

The name of the technique/sub-technique associated with the behavior.
Objective
The name of the objective associated with the behavior.

The description of the pattern associated with the action taken on the behavior.

.
DnsRequests{}.CausedDetect
True/false – indicates whether the Domain lookup triggered the detect.
DnsRequests{}.DomainName
Domain Name from DnsRequest events.
DnsRequests{}.RequestType
The DNS request type. For more information on DNS request types, see DNS Constants on MSDN.
FilesAccessed{}.FileName
Name of the file accessed.
Note: There can be 0 or more FilesAccessed_FileName entries, each with its own timestamp.
FilesAccessed{}.FilePath
File path, if a file was accessed.
Note: There can be 0 or more FilesAccessed_FilePath entries.
FilesAccessed{}.Timestamp
Time when the file was accessed, in Unix epoch time.
FilesWritten{}.FileName
Name of the executable file that was written.
Note: There can be 0 or more FilesWritten_FileName entries, each with its own timestamp.
FilesWritten{}.FilePath
File path where the file was written.
Note: There can be 0 or more FilesWritten_FilePath entries.
FilesWritten{}.Timestamp
Time when the file was written, in Unix epoch time.
FalconHostLink
Link to view detection event in Falcon console.
FileName
File name if a file is involved in the detection.
FilePath
File path if a file is involved in the detection.
GrandParentCommandLine
The command line used to create the grandparent process.
GrandParentImageFileName
Grandparent image file name.
IOARuleInstanceID
Numerical ID of the custom IOA rule under a given CID. This field is included for an event when a custom IOA rule
triggers the detection.
IOARuleInstanceVersion
Version number of the InstanceID that triggered. This field increments when the rule is revised or updated and is
included for an event when a custom IOA rule triggers the detection.
IOARuleName
Name given to the custom IOA rule that triggered. This field is included for an event when a custom IOA rule
triggers the detection.
IOARuleGroupName
Name of the rule group that the rule belongs to. This field is included for an event when a custom IOA rule
triggers the detection.
IOCValue
The CrowdStrike Intelligence indicator that triggered the detection. Example: baddomain.com
IOCType
The type of the indicator. Possible values are: domain, filename, hash_md5, hash_sha256, registry_key,
